degree_rationale: Four types existing in the eye and a fifth hidden — the four (water, fire, darkness, light/air) with the fifth being the living air watching all. Why the eye sees by day but not by night — mystery of the Pupil and First Man's coming-forth-and-knowing. Treats the body's outer-organ structure as cosmic seal.
direction_rationale: West-turn at natural: the body's outermost — the eye — as the settled cosmic seal where all four elements plus the watching fifth come to rest. Completion-in-organ.
grand_man_function: Natural eye-completion — the outermost organ as cosmic seal.
title: Three forms in the eye and four hidden in the body
